_about: Registry of PUBLIC reference documents the fetcher may download. Only hosts listed under 'allowed_hosts' are ever contacted. UL Product iQ is deliberately absent: it requires a login and its terms do not permit automated retrieval; UL designs are pulled by a person and parsed with `ffs import-ul-design`. Entries with url=null are known documents whose exact URL has not been confirmed yet; the fetcher skips them and lists them so a person (or a session with network access) can confirm the link.

_host_notes.msds.carboline.com: Carboline (RPM) document servlet: PDS, SDS, UL printouts. TLS needs OpenSSL legacy renegotiation (OPENSSL_CONF with UnsafeLegacyServerConnect).
_host_notes.javapublic1.rpmsfa.com: RPM servlet behind carboline.com fireproofing pages: primer/topcoat lists, design flowcharts, evaluation reports.
_host_notes.www.carboline-me.com: Carboline Middle East; hosts Pyrolite documents absent from the US site.
_host_notes.carboline.canto.com: NOT allowed: robots.txt Disallow: /. Its documents are listed for manual download (ffs manual-list, ffs import-manual).
_host_notes.www.paintdocs.com: Sherwin-Williams document server; extension-less URLs that return application/pdf.
_host_notes.gcpat.com: HTML pages are challenge-gated and never fetched; PDFs under /sites/gcpat.com/files/ are served.
_host_notes.ca.gcpat.com: GCP Canada; some PDFs answer 200 although HTML answers 403.
_host_notes.iq.ulprospector.com: NEVER fetched: login and terms forbid automated retrieval; UL designs are pulled by a person.
_host_notes.beta.gcpat.com: GCP's own staging host; serves the same /sites/default/files/ documents as gcpat.com without the challenge.
_host_notes.www.ppg.com: PPG PMC catalogue (www.ppgpmc.com redirects here); product pages embed DAM links on dam-cdn.ppg.com / max.ppg.com.
_host_notes.buyat.ppg.com: NOT allowed: PPG SDS server refuses non-browser clients (SDS are a manual download).
_host_notes.international.brand.akzonobel.com: AkzoNobel DAM for International Paint TDS and guides; robots allows all.
_host_notes.files-ask.hilti.com: Hilti-owned attachment bucket behind the Ask Hilti engineering Q&A pages.
_host_notes.productdata.hilti.com: NOT allowed: robots.txt Disallow /APQ_HC_RAW/ (the host behind Hilti's Download buttons); listed for manual download.
_host_notes.cp.jotun.com: NOT allowed: robots.txt Disallow: /; Jotun DoPs and brochures are a manual download.
_host_notes.www.hempel.com: Product pages allowed; the /api/ PDS endpoint is robots-disallowed and is not fetched (manual download).
